description: The plot illustrates MRR@10 performance as a function of the number of queries used during inference (S) for four DPR variants. The x-axis is labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S).” and uses a linear scale with integer values from 1 to 10, shown at regular 1-unit intervals. The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” on a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with tick marks at 0.5 increments. A black solid horizontal line (no markers) labeled “DPR w/o query” stays constant at approximately 34.25 across all S values. A red solid line with circular markers labeled “DPR w/ corpus expansion” starts near 35.15 at S=1, rises to about 35.55 at S=2, and then remains in a narrow band around roughly 35.55–35.80 through S=10, with points near 35.78 at S=7 and about 35.77 at S=10. A green solid line with upward triangle markers labeled “DPR w/ document expansion” stays close to 34.8–34.95 across the range, beginning around 34.78 at S=1, reaching about 34.92 at S=6, and ending near 34.85 at S=10. A blue solid line with star markers labeled “DPR w/ asymmetric expansion” fluctuates around the mid–34s, starting near 34.75 at S=1, peaking around 35.00 at S=2 and again near 35.00 at S=5, then trending downward after S=5 to approximately 34.65 at S=8 and about 34.38 at S=10.
